changes.utility: Washington investor-owned electric utilities (Puget Sound Energy, Avista, PacifiCorp in Washington)
changes.rule_name: Washington UTC draft Policy Statement Addressing Electric Large Load Customers (UE-260162)
changes.source_title: Washington UTC, Notice of Draft Policy Statement and Opportunity to Comment by November 25, 2026, Docket UE-260162 (with the draft Policy Statement Addressing Electric Large Load Customers)
changes.what: The UTC issued a draft policy statement for its regulated investor-owned utilities that would treat customers of 50 MW maximum contracted capacity (and, by presumption, over 20 MW at over 75 percent load factor) as large load customers and expects minimum terms, exit fees and collateral for the full contract term, with comments due 25 November 2026 and a final statement planned by year-end.

cites.quote: Service Date: November 6, 2026
NOTICE OF DRAFT POLICY STATEMENT AND OPPORTUNITY TO COMMENT BY NOVEMBER 25, 2026
The Commission plans to publish a final version of this policy statement by the end of the calendar year.
To exclude traditional industrial loads from LLC classification, the Commission believes that a threshold of 50 MW is appropriate.
Commission presumes that a customer with greater than 20 MW of demand and a load factor of greater than 75 percent is an LLC, even if the capacity-only criterion is not met.
Utilities should require that LLCs commit to a minimum contract term sufficient to fully recover the incremental fixed costs of serving them
LLC tariffs should include credit, deposit, and collateral requirements for the full contract term.

changes.license_basis: the Washington UTC's own docket documents (utc.wa.gov case docket, robots allowed)
changes.notes: The draft binds no named utility; it says the Commission regulates investor-owned electric utilities, not PUDs, municipals or cooperatives (footnote 6). A petition for rulemaking by Green Recursive Utility Service LLC (filed 3 November 2026) on measuring large loads is in the same docket. The UTC's Notice of Timeline of 13 October 2026 was not read.
